p: wickedness profit nothing: That is, wickedly gotten.
not allow the soul of the: Though he permits the just to want for a time, yet he will send him comfort in due season.
the wicked: When their wickedness is discovered, they will be as dumb and not know what to say.
perish: Shall be vile and abhorred both by God and man, contrary to their own expectation, who think to make their name immortal.
winketh with the eye causeth sorrow: That bears a fair countenance and imagines mischief in his heart, as in Pr 6:13.
prating fool shall fall: For the corruption of his heart is known by his talk.
a rod is for the back: That is, God will find him out to punish him.
strong city: And so makes him bold to do evil, while poverty bridles the poor from many evil things.
feed many: For they speak truth and edify many by exhortations, admonition and counsel.
no sorrow with it: Meaning that all worldly things bring care and sorrow, where as they who feel the blessings of God have none.
send him: He is trouble and grief to him about any business.
shall be shortened: The time of their prosperity will be short because of their great fall, though they seem to live long.
never be removed: They enjoy in this life by faith and hope, their everlasting life.
